description: Opened from a chat page on a phone, the sidebar drawer is scrolled to the active chat, so the Pages group with Contacts is above the visible area; from the Contacts page it opens at the top.
expected: Drawer opens with the Pages rows visible, or the current page row in view.
actual: Contacts row top at -14 px (hidden) when the drawer opens on /app. Touch scrolling not confirmed.
suggested_fix: Scroll the drawer list to the top when it opens, or only scroll to the active row when it is outside the viewport and Pages is not.
